bus_script: SELECT f.sale_id, f.sale_date, f.amount, f.quantity, c.customer_name, c.region, p.product_name, p.category, d.date_key, d.month, d.year FROM dbo.fact_sales f JOIN dbo.dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN dbo.dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id JOIN dbo.dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE f.sale_date >= DATEADD(day, -1, GETDATE())

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.email, c.phone, c.region, c.segment, a.address_line1, a.city, a.state, a.zip, o.total_orders, o.total_spend FROM dbo.dim_customer c LEFT JOIN dbo.dim_address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id LEFT JOIN dbo.agg_orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

SELECT i.item_id, i.item_name, i.sku, w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, w.location, inv.quantity_on_hand, inv.reorder_level, inv.last_updated FROM dbo.fact_inventory inv JOIN dbo.dim_item i ON inv.item_id = i.item_id JOIN dbo.dim_warehouse w ON inv.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
